question: Please help me find the film category with the highest total rental hours in cities where the city's name either starts with "A" or contains a hyphen.
sql:
-- Check for ties at the top
SELECT c.name AS category_name,
       SUM(CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.return_date - r.rental_date)) / 3600 AS DECIMAL(15,2))) AS total_rental_hours
FROM rental r
JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
JOIN film_category fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id
JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id
JOIN customer cust ON r.customer_id = cust.customer_id
JOIN address addr ON cust.address_id = addr.address_id
JOIN city ct ON addr.city_id = ct.city_id
WHERE ct.city LIKE 'A%' OR ct.city LIKE '%-%'
GROUP BY c.name
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.return_date - r.rental_date)) / 3600 AS DECIMAL(15,2))) DESC) = 1
